newsitem.title: USA: Calif. to set rules for unregulated utility units.
newsitem.headline: Calif. to set rules for unregulated utility units.

text.p: The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) on Wednesday opened a proceeding to set standards for relationships between California energy utilities and their unregulated affiliate units.
The proceeding will also determine whether utilities should be required to have their unregulated activities conducted by the affiliates, the CPUC said.

"Given the potential for self-dealing and cross-subsidization which could surface as California's electric industry becomes increasingly competitive, it makes sense to recraft and standardize rules specific to natural gas and electric utilities and their energy affiliates...," the commssion said in a statement.
The CPUC directed interested parties, including Pacific Gas & Electric Co and Southern California Edison Co, to develop and propose rules by June 1.
